create_bbox_xyxy_to_xywh: convert bounding box from xyxy format to xywh format using numpy
adjust_camera_bbox_crop: adjust camera focal length and principal point for a bounding box crop
adjust_camera_image_scale: adjust camera parameters when resizing an image to a new dimensions
normalize_cameras: normalize a set of cameras so optical axes point to origin and first camera is at origin
compute_optical_transform: compute transform so optical axes of cameras intersect at a common point
first_camera_transform: transform cameras so the first camera becomes the origin
normalize_translation: normalize camera translation vectors by their average scale
